The firmware runs on ESP32-C3 with ESP-IDF 5.5.3 and FreeRTOS. Application code resides in Firmware/main/. Board support resides in Firmware/components/bsp/. The figures below describe the 284ab00 snapshot.

Figure 9. Firmware layers. Green frames mark plain C modules that run in host tests without LVGL or ESP-IDF.


The design separates two concerns:

Logic remains independent of hardware. The state machine, key mapping, protocol codec, session rules, and ADPCM use plain C.
The build compiles the flow graph. flowc.py converts coach.flow.json into C transition tables. The device executes these tables without a graph parser or interpreter.

Startup order

01Read the wake causeAfter a key wake, suppress key actions until release or the 10 s timeout.
02Initialize I2C, display, and LVGLA display or LVGL failure stops application startup and logs the SPI pins. Successful initialization sets the backlight to 100%.
03Initialize audio and fuel gaugeInitialize ES8311 and CW2017. Record failures without stopping application startup.
04Start the Coach appCreate queues and timers. Start voice, BLE, and the coach task. Voice or BLE failure leaves the screens and keys available.
05Enable key inputQueue key events only after the app is ready.


Tasks and queues


Figure 10. Task priorities, stack sizes, and queues.


The priorities favor audio and transport:

voice: 7. It processes 20 ms audio blocks. Late delivery can cause gaps in playback.
ble_tx: 6. It prioritizes the control queue. AGENT_END uses the audio queue and follows the last AUDIO_UP packet.
coach: 5. It handles keys, timers, and link events through one queue. State transitions execute sequentially.
LVGL: 4. Drawing has lower priority than audio and transport.

Sequential state transitions do not remove every concurrency requirement. Other tasks must hold bsp_lvgl_lock() before they access LVGL. Link callbacks also require the link mutex.
Each queue uses a fixed capacity. Control TX and audio TX each hold eight packets. Audio overflow discards the oldest packet. Control overflow discards the incoming packet and logs a warning.
State machine
flowc.py generates 10 states and 83 transitions from coach.flow.json into main/generated/coach_flow.c.



Group
States
Description




Pages
LIVE, REPORT, TURNS
Live data, report, and Turns. Short UP and DOWN presses navigate the page loop.


Coach
READY, CAPTURE, WAIT_ANSWER, PLAYBACK
Ready, recording, waiting for an answer, and playback.


Popup
POPUP_WAIT, POPUP_PLAY, POPUP_HOLD
Waiting for audio, playing audio, and the 10 s countdown.



Two timers control recording and response progress:

After 20 s in CAPTURE, the timer sends CAPTURE_LIMIT and ends recording.
After 10 s without progress in WAIT_ANSWER, the timer sends AGENT_TIMEOUT. Each non-failure AGENT_STATE message restarts this timer.

Only one application page remains allocated at a time. A page change loads a persistent blank screen, removes the old page, then builds the new page. This sequence limits peak LVGL allocation.
The page rail remains on the LVGL top layer across page changes. One object draws its four stops and thumb.
Audio path

Up · recordingMicrophone to phoneES8311 supplies 16 kHz, 16-bit mono samples. The voice task encodes one 164-byte ADPCM block each 20 ms. The audio TX queue holds eight packets and discards the oldest packet on overflow. The ble_tx task sends each packet as a NimBLE notification.
Down · playbackPhone to speakerNimBLE receives the packet. link_core checks the exchange identifier, xid, and accepts only the current stream. The down queue holds eight blocks and discards the oldest block on overflow. play_gate controls playback start. The voice task decodes each block and sends PCM through I2S and ES8311 to the speaker.


A 20 s recording at 16 kHz, 16-bit mono needs 640,000 bytes of raw PCM. The device streams blocks during recording, so it does not retain the complete recording in RAM.

启动顺序

01读取唤醒原因按键唤醒后屏蔽按键操作，直到按键释放或达到 10 s 超时。
02初始化 I2C、显示和 LVGL显示或 LVGL 初始化失败时，记录 SPI 引脚并停止应用启动。初始化成功后将背光设为 100%。

任务和队列


图 10　任务优先级、栈大小和队列。


任务优先级向音频和传输倾斜：

voice：7。 处理 20 ms 音频块。交付延迟可能导致播放断音。
ble_tx：6。 优先发送控制队列中的包。AGENT_END 使用音频队列，排在最后一个 AUDIO_UP 之后。
coach：5。 按键、计时器和链路事件进入同一队列，状态转移按顺序执行。
LVGL：4。 绘制优先级低于音频和传输。

状态转移串行执行不代表没有并发约束。其他任务访问 LVGL 前必须持有 bsp_lvgl_lock()。链路回调同样需要链路互斥锁保护。
队列容量固定。控制发送队列和音频发送队列各容纳八个包。音频队列溢出时丢弃最旧的包；控制队列溢出时丢弃新包并记录警告。
状态机
flowc.py 从 coach.flow.json 生成 10 个状态和 83 条转移，输出至 main/generated/coach_flow.c。



组
状态
说明




页面
LIVE、REPORT、TURNS
实时数据、报告和弯型。短按 UP、DOWN 在页面循环中导航


教练
READY、CAPTURE、WAIT_ANSWER、PLAYBACK
就绪、录音、等待回答和播放


弹窗
POPUP_WAIT、POPUP_PLAY、POPUP_HOLD
等待语音、播放语音和 10 s 倒计时



两个计时器控制录音时长和回答进展：

CAPTURE 持续 20 s 后产生 CAPTURE_LIMIT，结束录音。
WAIT_ANSWER 连续 10 s 无进展后产生 AGENT_TIMEOUT。每条非失败状态的 AGENT_STATE 消息都会重新计时。

同一时间只保留一个应用页面。切换时先加载常驻的空白界面，再删除旧页面并创建新页面，以限制 LVGL 内存分配峰值。
页面导轨常驻 LVGL 顶层，切换页面时不删除。四个刻度和滑块均由同一个对象绘制。
音频通路

上行 · 录音麦克风 → 手机ES8311 提供 16 kHz、16-bit 单声道采样。voice 任务每 20 ms 编码一个 164 字节的 ADPCM 块。音频发送队列容纳八个包，溢出时丢弃最旧的包。ble_tx 通过 NimBLE 通知发送数据包。
下行 · 播放手机 → 喇叭NimBLE 接收数据包。link_core 检查会话标识 xid，只接受当前流。下行队列容纳八个块，溢出时丢弃最旧的块。play_gate 控制播放启动。voice 任务将数据解码为 PCM，再经 I2S 和 ES8311 输出至喇叭。


20 s、16 kHz、16-bit 单声道录音需要 640,000 字节的裸 PCM。设备在录音时持续发送音频块，不在 RAM 中保存完整录音。
